newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank head says money market liquid.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank head says money market liquid.

text.p: Bank of Thailand governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Thursday the country's money market enjoyed fair liquidity this week despite relatively high local interbank rates.
Rerngchai said liquidity was partly boosted late last month when a new eight billion baht ($320 million) provident fund of Bank of Thailand staff started investing in the domestic market.
He said the fund, pooled from the savings of about 5,000 central bank employees, was being managed by three local fund managers.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 13.50 percent on Thursday morning from 14.00-14.50 late on Monday.
"The overall liquidity is still good," Rerngchai said.
He added that the central bank would also try to keep interbank rates at high levels to discourage local speculation on a strong U.S. dollar. He did not elaborate.
